_about: Key-to-icon mapping for the LOCAL icon build of the MSFS 2024 default Cessna Citation CJ4 profile (docs/icons.md; personal use only, never committed: the icon profile and the images are written to the git-ignored .local/ folder). Names and sha256 only, in the form of icons-visionjet-sf50.json. Rows of keys that the CJ4 shares by page, position and title with the VisionJet profile before its main page changed (V-UX) are that mapping's rows, then the C172 G1000 mapping's; the compad rows are the VisionJet mapping's as they are; the other rows follow one rule per key kind. Only pack files that the committed mappings already name. Not yet look-tested.

ATCbutton.png.pack: Standard Avionics Suite/icons/Standard AP NAV COM XPDR/ATCbutton.png
